summary: Verified new AllergoLab features: admin-only 'Configurazione' tab (RBAC), admin CRUD on /api/admin/allergens, catalog auto-reload after admin changes, per-user report isolation. Backend: 13 pytest cases pass (RBAC 403 for normal user on all 4 admin endpoints, 401 unauth, admin list/create/update/delete/duplicate/invalid-type/404, report isolation between admin + 2 registered users). Frontend: UI flow validated end-to-end via Playwright — admin sees tab-config, performs create/edit/delete of a zTEST allergen (dialog + toast + row visible/updated/removed), catalog in 'Nuovo Report' reflects the change, admin logout, new user registration and login: tab-config NOT rendered, Storico is empty (does not see admin's reports).
critical_code_review_comments: get_admin_user correctly returns 403 for non-admin and 401 (via get_current_user) for unauthenticated — verified.

Report ownership is enforced at query time (user_id filter on GET list/single/delete) — a normal user attempting to GET/DELETE another user's report_id gets 404, not 403 (leak-free by obscurity, acceptable).
loadAllergens is passed as onChanged to AdminAllergens and re-invoked after every create/update/delete, so DualList in 'Nuovo Report' stays in sync — confirmed via UI.
tab-config is conditionally rendered based on user.role === 'admin' both on the TabsTrigger AND on the TabsContent — good defensive rendering.

Minor: admin update endpoint allows renaming the code (PUT /api/admin/allergens/{code} with body.code != code). AdminAllergens.jsx uses editingCode (original code) for URL. Works correctly, but not exercised by UI flow (kept for completeness).

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral zTEST allergen created and deleted within the test flow; ephemeral report records created and deleted; two throwaway users are registered (test_user_*, test_user2_*, uitest_*). No cleanup of registered users done — main agent may prune if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression pytest suites present at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (auth, allergens, aggregate, reports CRUD) and /app/backend/tests/test_admin_and_isolation.py (RBAC + admin CRUD + report isolation). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests -v. 282 allergens seeded in db.allergens. Admin CRUD UI in AdminAllergens.jsx uses data-testid: admin-search-input, admin-add-allergen-button, admin-form-{code,type,name,siss-code,siss-description,save}, admin-edit-<code>, admin-delete-<code>, admin-allergen-row-<code>, admin-allergen-count.
